name: Lozito Law, LLC
what_they_do: Small real-estate-focused practice run by Danielle M. Lozito, Esq., handling residential and commercial real-estate transactions and simple estate planning. It also describes itself as a litigation practice. The office address on the site is 480 Georges Rd, North Brunswick, not Milltown, although the page title says 'Milltown, NJ'.
customers: Home buyers and sellers, commercial property clients and estate-planning clients in Middlesex County.

size_signals.signal: One named attorney (Danielle M. Lozito, Esq.) with one North Brunswick office; general Gmail address published as the contact email
Google panel shows 4.4 at 'real estate attorney' category (review count not displayed in the limited view I loaded)
Third-party directory Birdeye lists 83 reviews, described as 4.5 - not verified against Google

listing.reviews: not displayed in the limited panel view I could load

website_review.phone_layout: unverified - the site's NinjaFirewall returned a 403 to my browser so I assessed it from fetched HTML; the HTML has no tel: links at all
website_review.primary_cta: None - no button, no form; the 'Contact' menu item is an anchor to a text block with phone, fax and a Gmail address
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: None; no form, no scheduler, no quote request
website_review.trust_signals: Attorney bio, Google rating 4.4, LinkedIn profile link; thin otherwise
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Only two real pages (Home and About with anchors for Legal/Contact); /contact/ returns the homepage content with a canonical pointing at the homepage, so there is effectively no contact page; description contains the typo 'Specialing'
website_review.search_basics: Title names real estate lawyer and 'Milltown, NJ' but the office is North Brunswick - location mismatch; no separate service pages; Yoast Organization schema carries only name, logo and LinkedIn, no address or phone
top_issues: No contact form, no click-to-call and no booking - the only paths are a printed phone number or a Gmail address
No real contact page (the /contact/ URL serves the homepage) and no dedicated service pages
Town mismatch: title says Milltown, address is North Brunswick - confusing for both customers and search engines

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: Google panel loads with rating, category, address, hours and website, but it showed no review count, no reviews tab and a single photo, and the panel flagged a 'limited view'; robots.txt (Yoast) allows all. Answerable: services, address and phone are plain text a crawler can read, but schema is Organization-only with no address/phone/hours and there is no price content. Bookable: nothing - no form, no scheduler; the only machine-usable channel is a published Gmail address.

operations_signals.signal: Client contact runs through a personal Gmail address and a phone number - all inquiry handling is manual
Real-estate closing work is document-heavy and repetitive, yet the site offers no client intake or document checklist (inference from the practice type, not stated on the site)
Third-party review summaries mention communication and attention-to-detail complaints alongside praise for closings

top_opportunities.opportunity: Build a real contact page with a labelled intake/quote form (transaction type, property address, target closing date) that emails or posts into a CRM
top_opportunities.evidence: No form anywhere on the site; contact is a text block with a Gmail address

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add legal-service schema plus click-to-call and fix the Milltown/North Brunswick location mismatch in titles and on-page copy
top_opportunities.evidence: Organization schema has no address or phone; title says Milltown while the address block says North Brunswick

top_opportunities.opportunity: Document-intake and status-update automation for closings (checklist requests, e-signature hand-off, milestone emails)
top_opportunities.evidence: Practice is almost entirely residential/commercial real-estate transactions handled by one attorney

scores.reasons: Almost everything an AI agent would need is missing (no form, no booking, no local schema, no tel link); a single-attorney real-estate practice has real closing revenue but limited budget; the fixes are small and self-contained; findings are direct from fetched HTML, robots.txt and the Google panel, though browser rendering was blocked.

wrong_claims.claim: A one-attorney practice - 'One named attorney (Danielle M. Lozito, Esq.)', and the opportunity 'closings handled by one attorney'
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The About page profiles two attorneys: Danielle M. Lozito, Esq. (NY Law School 2002) and Alyssa N. Seiden, Esq. (Hofstra 2001). Two office lines (848-202-1650 and 848-202-1651) plus fax 848-202-1653 are published on every page.
